nodes.speaker: Nguoi dan chuyen
nodes.text: Nhung trang ho so dau tien mo ra. Mot dat nuoc mat chu quyen, mot xa hoi bi dat duoi ach cai tri, va mot cau hoi bat dau hien len.

nodes.speaker: Ho so thuoc dia
nodes.prompt: Tren ban do cuoi the ky XIX - dau the ky XX, ban can xac dinh mau thuan lon nhat cua xa hoi Viet Nam luc nay.

options.label: Mau thuan lon nhat la giua dan toc Viet Nam va thuc dan Phap.
options.feedback: Chinh xac. Ho so cho thay doc lap, chu quyen bi xam pham; mau thuan dan toc voi chu nghia thuc dan tro thanh yeu cau cap thiet nhat.

options.label: Mau thuan trong xa hoi thuoc dia co nhieu mat, nhung noi bat nhat van la van de dan toc.
options.feedback: Nhan dinh co co so, nhung can noi ro hon: trong boi canh mat nuoc, mau thuan trung tam la giua dan toc Viet Nam va thuc dan Phap.

options.label: Mau thuan chu yeu la giua cac phong trao yeu nuoc voi nhau.
options.feedback: Moi lien ket sai lech. Cac phong trao co khuynh huong khac nhau, nhung do khong phai mau thuan lon nhat cua xa hoi thuoc dia.

options.label: Mau thuan chi nam trong noi bo trieu dinh phong kien.
options.feedback: Ho so khong ung ho ket luan nay. Van de lich su bao trum la dat nuoc mat doc lap va nhan dan bi ap buc duoi che do thuoc dia.

nodes.speaker: Nhung ngon lua cu
nodes.prompt: Can Vuong va Yen The hien len nhu nhung ngon lua ben bi. Ban se ghi chu dac diem cua cac phong trao nay nhu the nao?

options.label: Can Vuong va Yen The the hien long yeu nuoc manh me nhung con gioi han boi khuynh huong phong kien.
options.feedback: Ho so duoc phan loai dung. Cac phong trao nay rat gia tri ve tinh than yeu nuoc, nhung chua dap ung yeu cau moi cua lich su.

options.label: Cac phong trao nay co tinh than dau tranh cao, nhung chua du de mo ra duong loi moi.
options.feedback: Dung mot phan. Can bo sung khuynh huong lich su cua chung: chu yeu van gan voi gioi han phong kien.

options.label: Cac phong trao nay khong co y nghia vi cuoi cung that bai.
options.feedback: Nhan dinh nay phu nhan sai vai tro lich su. That bai khong xoa bo tinh than yeu nuoc va y chi dau tranh cua nhan dan.

options.label: Cac phong trao nay da xac dinh duoc con duong cach mang hien dai.
options.feedback: Sai trong tam. Tai lieu cho thay cac phong trao cuoi cung van chua tim duoc duong loi phu hop voi thoi dai moi.

nodes.speaker: Nhung khuynh huong moi
nodes.prompt: Dong Du, Duy Tan va Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc dua nhung luong tu tuong moi vao xa hoi. Ban danh gia chung ra sao?

options.label: Dong Du, Duy Tan, Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc gop phan thuc tinh dan toc nhung van chua dua cach mang den thang loi.
options.feedback: Chinh xac. Ho so ghi nhan ca dong gop thuc tinh dan toc lan gioi han cua cac khuynh huong dau the ky XX.

options.label: Cac khuynh huong moi giup xa hoi Viet Nam tiep xuc voi tu tuong tien bo hon.
options.feedback: Dung nhung chua du. Can thay rang chung van that bai, tu do lam ro hon cuoc khung hoang ve duong loi cuu nuoc.

options.label: Chi can dua vao su giup do cua nuoc ngoai la co the gianh doc lap.
options.feedback: Ket luan nay lech voi tai lieu. Nguyen Tat Thanh khong chon cach dua dam vao ben ngoai, ma muon tu minh quan sat va kiem nghiem thuc te.

options.label: Cac phong trao dau the ky XX hoan toan khong lien quan den qua trinh tim duong cuu nuoc.
options.feedback: Sai. Chinh nhung thanh cong gioi han va that bai cua cac phong trao nay tao nen bai hoc lich su quan trong.

nodes.speaker: Cau hoi cua lich su
nodes.prompt: Cac con duong cu lan luot khep lai. Tu su that bai cua cac phong trao yeu nuoc, ban rut ra ket luan nao?

options.label: Su that bai cua cac phong trao cho thay cach mang Viet Nam khung hoang ve duong loi cuu nuoc va can phuong huong moi.
options.feedback: Ho so duoc khoi phuc dung mach. Long yeu nuoc da co, nhung lich su can mot con duong cuu nuoc moi phu hop hon.

options.label: Cac phong trao that bai nhung van de lai bai hoc va tinh than yeu nuoc.
options.feedback: Dung mot phan, nhung chua cham vao ket luan trung tam: cuoc khung hoang ve duong loi cuu nuoc.

options.label: Nhan dan Viet Nam khong co tinh than dau tranh nen cac phong trao that bai.
options.feedback: Sai. Tai lieu khang dinh tinh than yeu nuoc va y chi dau tranh rat manh me; van de nam o duong loi va phuong thuc.

options.label: Chi can lap lai phuong phap cu thi cuoi cung se thang loi.
options.feedback: Moi lien ket khong chinh xac. Thuc tien that bai cho thay khong the chi lap lai cac phuong phap cu.

nodes.speaker: Tong ket chuong I
nodes.text: Ban da khoi phuc duoc van de mo dau: long yeu nuoc da co, nhung duong loi dung van chua tim thay. Hanh trinh phai bat dau tu cau hoi ay.
